mostWorthwhile.text: Tracing the refusal through the policy and reserved-capacity log was most worthwhile: it connected the idle van to human commercial choices rather than treating the algorithm as the sole cause.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the rails and mounting the carrier felt somewhat procedural; the physical details were clear, but the sequence offered little tension.

surprise.text: The van was idle because its availability had been sold to somebody else, not simply because the depot lacked a vehicle.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless, though the investigation became a sequence of only available combinations rather than a choice about how to proceed.

continue.text: Yes. The connection between practical repair and the choices embedded in shared infrastructure makes me curious about how the neighborhood might challenge the rule, even if the fast-mode choices were sometimes procedural.
